name: Kamata
tagline: Shinagawa in 15 minutes and Shibuya in 28 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, where JR East and Tokyu run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 35 minutes to Otemachi, 34 minutes to Shinjuku, 28 minutes to Shibuya and 15 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 3.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 3.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.5 m to 4 m, a difference of 1.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: マルエツ かまた店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 17 clinics and 16 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 牧田総合病院　B館, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 常田病院, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Keihin-Tohoku Line run through it. Tokyu Ikegami Line and Tokyu Tamagawa Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line and Tokyu runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川; trains from here toward 品川 pass through it. Tokyu Ikegami Line runs at 130%. Trains from here toward 五反田 also pass through its busiest stretch, 大崎広小路→五反田. Tokyu Tamagawa Line runs at 112% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 矢口渡→蒲田, which includes this station. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For quiet, Hasunuma; for how close the centre is, Kamata.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kamata. Both have the Tokyu Ikegami Line. Kamata also has the JR Keihin-Tohoku Line and Tokyu Tamagawa Line, which Hasunuma does not. Kamata is at least 7 minutes quicker to Toranomon and Tokyo. On quiet, though, Hasunuma comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Kamata is ahead on how close the centre is, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kamata. Kamata adds the JR Keihin-Tohoku Line, Tokyu Ikegami Line and Tokyu Tamagawa Line; Keikyu-Kamata adds the Keikyu Main Line and Keikyu Airport Line. Kamata is at least 10 minutes quicker to Shinjuku and Shibuya. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

goodFor: People who want another route when a line stops
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
noiseSources: 多摩堤通り (1 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 18 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning trains are very crowded: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line trains toward 品川 pass through the line's busiest stretch further on.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
